digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and Git fetch optimization
propositions: CI ticket fetches must apply --filter=blob:none to all checkout paths to reduce transfer cost from 1.04-6.73 GiB to 22-68.7 MiB
actions/checkout@v7 filter input must be added to reconcile-bridge, verify-identity, and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows while preserving fetch-depth:0 and existing credentials
Gerrit direct-URL fetches require explicit --filter=blob:none; depth-1 require-ticket fetch and full-history verify-identity fetch must each inherit named-remote filter or have it set explicitly
Production guards must parse git count-objects size-pack output and reject fetches exceeding REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB (102400) and REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB (131072) limits
Real-Git fixture with git daemon must demonstrate blob:none capability negotiation via GIT_TRACE_PACKET inspection and prove missing-object behavior before and after worktree materialization
Blobless partial clone must preserve complete commit graph for merge-base operations, reconverge independent changes, and leave git count-objects state unchanged after identity verification
